text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Just a little more...! To the finish line...!
Sprint through and win... with overwhelming dominance!!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Win, win... win...—!
I will show them... the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaaaarrrrghhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! As expected of an elite horse girl
from that prestigious family!
What an incredible run...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, she's definitely
one of the favorites for this year's Classic circuit!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of elites, there's one more!
I can't wait to see who's stronger between him and Satono Crown!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was incredible intensity...
It was wild, or rather... that's what made it so cool!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente showed us a magnificent run once again.
However, when she came back, her expression was—
choice_data_list: ...Still not satisfied with that?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I kept in mind what you told me.
However...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In the end,
I just couldn't hold myself back.
choice_data_list: The results were good, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That alone won't be enough.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"In a Classic race...
..."
choice_data_list: ...Dura?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win with style.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—I want to run in a way that makes me feel like the strongest...
and win the race of my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I need to find a countermeasure
before the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I racked my brain right alongside her as she pondered.
If only I knew her more deeply, perhaps there would be
something I could suggest, but—
choice_data_list: (...No, wait...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove has done
so much for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just maybe...
she might give me a hint.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —So that's why you came to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Looking for a way to keep Duramente
from getting too worked up.
choice_data_list: Could you please cooperate with us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown races come only once in a lifetime. That's why she's feeling the pressure too. Just a little longer until that crucial race—
choice_data_list: I want Dura to run her race with no regrets!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...When Dura was young,
there was an inter-school race tournament between the racing academies."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The runner chosen to represent the school
was terribly nervous. She was so consumed by the race
that she couldn't even hear the voices around her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, she fell far behind at the start,
which agitated her even more...
Everyone believed victory was now impossible.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, at that moment, her parents... especially her father, desperately shouted out "Duramente!" at the top of his lungs.
choice_data_list: That father did...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Just as you imagined,
they are usually very gentle and calm when cheering.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, on that day, they desperately raised their voices.
Perhaps their cries reached her, because—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dura regained her composure and, despite being at a massive disadvantage,
claimed a magnificent... victory.
choice_data_list: My voice... reached her consciousness.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The voices of her beloved parents truly must have held great power.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No. But that wasn't
a very realistic idea. Let's think of another—"
choice_data_list: Thank you, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Hey—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
She's so reckless, or maybe just naive...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still... someone like her might just be the one
to pry open Dura's world.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the Classic Triple Crown race just around the corner... Upon request from reporters, Duramente was scheduled to hold a press conference shortly.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—That concludes our meeting, then.
Shall we head to the press conference?
choice_data_list: Before that...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: Dura, will you trust me?
Dura, will you trust me?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What does this mean?
choice_data_list: I was taught a way to calm you down.
Someone taught me how to help calm you down.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see, Big Sis Groove did...
choice_data_list: Next time, I'll be the one shouting your name!
Next time, I'll be the one shouting your name!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, their voices reached me back then.
However...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna do it at the Satsuki Sho?
That's a race with over 50,000 people watching, you know.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, you can't even hear that massive roar of the crowd during a race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And yet...
how could I...
choice_data_list: That's why I want you to believe in me.
That's why I want you to believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason she heard her family's voices was likely because
those voices reside deep within her heart and reach her subconscious.
If that's the case—
choice_data_list: If you believe in me, I'll definitely reach it.
If you believe in me, it'll surely reach them.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I gratefully accept
your sentiment."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let's go.
It's time for the press conference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap... snap...*)
choice_data_list: (There are more people than before...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown races draw massive public attention. Combined with the high expectations for Duramente herself, a horde of reporters had gathered.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san!
The Classic Triple Crown races are finally about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho and Japan Derby, which she announced she will run in...
Both are monumental races that determine the pinnacle of the generation!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
We have received heartfelt messages from both her family
and everyone involved.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "Duramente will surely etch a vivid, striking page into the family history."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "Back at your debut, you said you didn't have anything in particular in mind... but looking at these upcoming races, I won't let you say you don't care!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"—Please, tell us
how you're feeling right now!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
My feelings?
They were decided long ago.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho is said to be the race
won by the fastest Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the sharpness of a late-race burst, I yield to no one.
I will claim victory without fail.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That's the first crown. I'll be taking it back to where it belongs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap... snap...*)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: (Dura...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The papers tomorrow will likely be plastered with Duramente's bold words. That will surely push her even further into a corner.
choice_data_list: (――I'll make sure my voice reaches you too.)
(――I'll make sure my voice reaches you too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her tremble faintly,
I renewed my resolve. As a mighty contender
forbidden from defeat... we head into the Satsuki Sho.
